Welcome to Love and Belonging at UCSB. This digital exhibition uses personal field observations to show how undergraduate students build community, care, and emotional safety across different campus spaces. University life is often filled with academic pressure and uncertainty. Therefore, finding a safe space and a supportive group is very important for mental health.
Through four distinct visual stories, this project explores how love and relationships naturally happen in daily student life. By analyzing these photographs through four academic texts from our class—written by Arthur C. Brooks, Amanda L. Forest & Kori Krueger, Karen Wu, and Emily Esfahani Smith—we will demonstrate how shared campus activities help students reduce stress. Ultimately, this exhibition proves that participating in shared environments and social rituals is the key to building true belonging as UCSB Gauchos.
